correctness.rationale: For any distinct v,w the Gram determinant ab-c²=det[v w]² is nonzero in any characteristic. Mellin expansion of values along the two punctured lines decomposes H into 2×2 character blocks, whose nontrivial Gauss sums are nonzero. With any Gram coefficient zero the blocks and 3×3 origin/trivial block invert. With all nonzero a,b,c, each block has corank one exactly if χ(r)=1 for r=ab/c², and the constant block adds the trivial-character kernel. This yields (q-1)/ord(r), with explicitly displayed fχ kernel basis and all q including char 2. For each nonisotropic base direction, partner lines v+z vperp give r=1+z²; exceptional z=0 or z²=-1 and isotropic first directions yield exact nonsingular pair count F_q and complete nullity incidence M_q(d), also q=2. Independently constructed complex Fourier matrices for every projective line pair at p=3,5,7 and matched nullity histograms. Algebraic character decomposition, not those experiments, proves all prime powers.
